d: Three-zone, networkable controller that combines a sound masking generator, third-octave band equalizer, and amplifier into one powerful, scalable platform.

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Power Supply:; Operating Voltage: 100-240VAC 50/60Hz; Current Draw: 0.9A;

specs.label: Sound Masking System
specs.value: Number of Masking Zones: 3 (2 cable runs per zone); Number of Non-Correlated Masking Sources: 4 per zone; Masking Level Adjustment: 0.5dB steps

specs.label: Control
specs.value: Remote Control:; Connector Type: Captive Screw Terminal; Input Type: Contact Closure (Normally Open); Number of Inputs: 2; Output Type: Logic Status (5VDC); Number of Outputs: 2; 2 Channels GPIO

specs.label: Weight
specs.value: 4.1 lbs (1.88 kg) (with surface mount bracket installed)

specs.label: Certifications
specs.value: FCC Part 15B (USA); UL Listed (USA and Canada); CE Marked (Europe); RoHS Directive (Europe); Met Works with WELL licensing criteria for sound masking;
